verdict.rationale: Otter's Enterprise page offers to keep an organization's data out of AI model training, but only by contacting an account manager (otter-docs-43). Community reading of the privacy statement indicates anonymized recordings are used as training data by default (otter-comm-6), which fits a sales-gated enterprise opt-out rather than contradicting it. missing for 10: a self-serve opt-out control, availability on non-enterprise or individual plans, detailed documentation of what the exclusion covers, and independent confirmation that the opt-out works.
